item.title: Boxing great Ruben Castillo, a world class featherweight, dies at 68
item.description: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. (KGET) – Local boxing great Ruben Castillo, a former four-time world title challenger, has passed away. Castillo, born in Lubbock, Texas, but raised largely in Bakersfield, fought a succession of boxing greats, including Julio Cesar Chavez and Alexis Arguello. He retired with 67 wins, 10 losses and two draws, with 35 knockouts, quitting for [...]
